slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: A local dashboard is a validation step
slides.subtitle: A team dashboard needs deployment, scheduled ingestion, and a durable destination.

slides.title: Start locally
slides.body: Read trace files, load them into DuckDB, open a Marimo report, and check whether the schema and charts make sense.

slides.title: Validate with human context
slides.body: Do the charts match your usage? Are important fields queryable? Did nested JSON become a usable schema?

slides.title: Then make it shareable
slides.body: Teams need scheduled pipeline runs, a cloud or private destination, and deployed reports that do not depend on a laptop.

slides.title: Keep privacy in mind
slides.body: Trace files can contain sensitive data. Use private storage or a warehouse destination when raw logs should not be shared directly.

slides.supportingText: From local agent traces to shareable dashboards with dltHub.
